McCrindle’s translation of the classical accounts of Alexander in India, the passage of the Indus, the battle with Porus and the return by the Indus (Westminster, 1896). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in Columbia University Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The invasion of India by Alexander the Great [microform], as described by Arrian, Q. Curtius, Diodoros, Plutarch and Justin; · McCrindle, John Watson, 1825-1913, Arrian. Anabasis, Curtius Rufus, Quintus, Diodorus, Siculus. Bibliotheca historica, Plutarch. Alexander, Justinus, Marcus Junianus · 1896, 256 scanned pages. Published 1896; John Watson McCrindle died 1913; the classical authors lived in antiquity; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit.
